title: Recurrent UTI renal risk review
limitations: Automated source-grounded reconstruction; medication, threshold, referral and safety wording is limited to explicit committed evidence.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports urinalysis, recommendation-qualified urine culture, and renal-function or electrolyte review in qualified pyelonephritis, nausea, or vomiting contexts.
user_facing_items.population: People presenting with dysuria in telehealth, with age, sex, pregnancy, comorbidity, recurrence, and complicated-infection qualifiers.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: UAE-direct for selected dysuria history, red-flag prompts, urinalysis, culture, and qualified renal-testing documentation. Physical examination, diagnosis, medicine, treatment, referral urgency, and non-telehealth pathways remain clinician responsibilities.
